confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from an RBA search result: the overview page showed 0.6720 USD per AUD for 2026-11-18. I did not open the page myself. Food and drink anchors rest on three searches. They found only rough Argentina-wide averages (July 2026: domestic beer about $3.47, café con leche about $3.53) and expat-guide meal ranges (inexpensive meal about $11, mid-range about $10-15 per person). I found no Mendoza-specific prices for cappuccino, cocktail or wine by the glass. Cocktail and wine are set from their usual relationship to beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not searched. Argentine prices in USD are volatile because of exchange-rate swings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Argentina-wide averages adjusted for Mendoza, a mid-priced tourist and wine city. Treated as somewhat cheaper than Buenos Aires and similar to Córdoba or Salta.
